question: In February 2023, Uttar Pradesh government launched a/an _____ called Family ID-One Family One Identity.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Portal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2023**, the Uttar Pradesh government launched a portal called **Family ID-One Family One Identity**.
 
• This portal aims to provide a **unique identity to each family in the state**.
 
• The initiative is designed to streamline and facilitate access to various government services and benefits for families.
 
• The Family ID will help in identifying families availing of benefits under different schemes and will ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries.
 
• The portal is expected to improve the efficiency of service delivery and reduce duplication of benefits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Family ID initiative is part of the broader efforts of the Uttar Pradesh government to leverage technology for better governance.
 
• It aligns with the **Digital India mission**, which aims to transform India into a **digitally empowered society **and knowledge economy.
 
• Families can register on the portal using basic information such as family members' details, address, and other relevant data.
 
• Once registered, each family will receive a unique Family ID that can be used to access various government services and schemes.
 
• The portal also features a user-friendly interface to ensure easy navigation and accessibility for all citizens.
